features: Dual-lens design: wide-angle prime lens (2MP, 1/2.7" CMOS) + 8-32mm motorized zoom lens (4MP, 1/1.8" CMOS); motorized focus and digital zoom
Omni-data structuring, multi-algorithm switchover, online loading and upgrade of algorithms
Behavior/crowd-flow analysis, target/person detection, object (motor vehicle/non-motorized vehicle/pedestrian) classification, vehicle recognition, vehicle event detection, traffic flow statistics
120 dB super wide dynamic range (WDR); backlight and overcast adaptation; defogging
Electronic image stabilization (EIS); built-in eMMC storage; SNR > 45 dB
release_notes: Specs sourced from the HOLOWITS product-center product page (no standalone datasheet PDF published for this ELI-E2 variant). The page lists only the 'Basic Spec' block; fields not stated there (IR range, video codecs/fps, audio, IP/IK rating, dimensions, weight, operating temperature) are omitted rather than assumed. Shares the 31500HAW dual-lens AI bullet hardware family as the QLI-E2 variant.
